metadata.head_note: output head is Linear(width, 4) for op_dest (4 classes) instead of Linear(width, 10) for y_true; the temporal reader body, causal padding, input features and validity-mask semantics are unchanged
metadata.statistical_discipline: Five frozen E checkpoints are the independent units; F is a control. The two readers are analysis-only, fit on Y's EXACT fixed 256-transition subset with Y's exact protocol, tuned on Y's canonical VAL, evaluated once on Y's untouched canonical TEST. Checkpoint selection is VAL-only; the best-on-TRAIN state is a diagnostic and is never used to select a deployable model; TEST is never used to select, tune or adjust. op_dest is used as a label only.

y_meta.obs_schema: 21-dim one-hot: op[0:3] (SET=0, SWAP=1, ADD=2), reg_a[3:7], reg_b[7:11], immediate[11:21]
y_meta.subset_design: deterministic fixed class-balanced small fitting subset of 256 UNIQUE ordinary-ADD transitions per seed, stratified by y_true over its 10 classes as evenly as possible ([26, 26, 26, 26, 26, 26, 25, 25, 25, 25]), drawn from W's top-scale pool10000; held-out operand pairs (b in {0,5}) excluded; no duplication; selection seed fixed before any fitting
y_meta.val: W's canonical ordinary VAL (cap 800/seed); identical to W, byte-verified
y_meta.test: W's untouched canonical strict TEST (all ADD); identical to W, byte-verified

primary_decision.rule_note: Z-INVALID if a class/split/recoverability invariant fails or the GRU control is <0.90 at some history; else Z-A if the TCN reaches >=0.90 train at BOTH L4 and Lfull; else Z-B if the TCN is <0.90 at BOTH; else Z-MIX (one history only). fit_bar=0.90 on the maximum observed training accuracy. Bars are declared conventions; continuous values reported.
